name: TypeUI DESIGN.md Extractor
summary: Chrome extension that extracts a website's styles and generates a DESIGN.md or SKILL.md blueprint for AI design tools.
description: Reads the active tab and extracts typography, colors, spacing, radius, shadows and motion, then drafts a DESIGN.md or SKILL.md file following the open-source TypeUI format for use with Google Stitch, Claude Code, Codex and similar tools. Generated sections include mission, brand, style foundations, WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, do and don't rules, and quality gates. The extension is loaded unpacked in Chrome and is MIT licensed.
contains: auto-extracts typography, colors, spacing, radius, shadows and motion from any site
output follows the open-source TypeUI DESIGN.md format
generated sections: mission, brand, style foundations, accessibility, rules, quality gates
generated guidance applies WCAG 2.2 AA requirements
actions: auto-extract, generate, refresh, download, explain
MIT licensed, loaded unpacked in Chrome
